source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/mhdv/hotelduvin (all 20 tabs downloaded fresh 2026-10-08 with the script's downloader after a robots.txt check; the 7 published tabs also rendered live in Chromium) + the 8 printed menu PDFs on hotelduvin.com downloaded fresh (cross-check only; PDF links re-confirmed on https://www.hotelduvin.com/locations/york/bistro/menus/)
notes: Refresh after page drift (calories-only chain). All 311 rows of items.csv (68 published + 243 held back; was 67 + 244) matched a live Chromium render of the 7 published tabs (read by the rendered tick / 'M' symbols and the card's Dietary Information lines, not the script's attribute parser) on calories, the 14 Contains/May marks and the named cereals/tree nuts (generic gluten/nuts where the same allergen is also under May contain, per policy 2); 114 page rows not in items.csv are 15 Country Table + 17 Market Table + 71 not-in-all-hotels cocktails + 1 bar snack (excluded by the script) and 10 exact repeats of kept dishes (same calories and marks). Changes vs the old data: Fish Pie renamed Traditional Fish Pie (new id, still held: 803 here vs 521 printed, seen on rendered alc PDF p5); Torres crisps moved 93/178/84 -> 733/907/781 kcal against the printed bar menu's 720/907/793 (seen on the rendered page), so only Black Truffle Crisps with Brie (907, contains milk) is released and published, the other two stay held; no other calories or Contains/May marks changed, the only other differences are cereal/nut names dropped to the generic allergen by the shared may-contain policy. The 198 PDF figures cited in holdback reasons were all found in the PDFs' text and about 25 dishes were read by eye on rendered PDF pages (bar p4, alc p5, kids p2); the reasons' fixed figures (cocktails, afternoon tea, pan bagnat, biscuit 0 kcal) still hold on the new pages. 7 NGCI / plant-based name flags re-read on the live pages and still ok. Not independently re-matched dish by dish: the PDF figures of the other held-back dishes (script anchors only; the figures themselves exist in the PDFs).
